title: RoboCurate: Harnessing Diversity with Action-Verified Synthetic Data for Robot Learning
abstract: arXiv:2602.18742v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Synthetic data generated by video generative models has shown promise for robot learning as a scalable pipeline, but it often suffers from noisy action labels due to imperfect video generation or inaccurate action prediction. Recently, vision-language models (VLMs) have been leveraged to validate video quality, but they cannot directly evaluate the generated actions themselves. To tackle this issue, we introduce RoboCurate, a novel framework for action-verified synthetic robot data that addresses inconsistencies between generated videos and annotated actions. Specifically, RoboCurate executes the actions predicted by an inverse dynamics model (IDM) in a simulator and verifies action consistency by measuring the motion agreement between the simulator rollout and the generated video. translated_title: RoboCurate：利用经动作验证的合成数据挖掘多样性以促进机器人学习
translated_abstract: 由视频生成模型生成的合成数据作为一种可扩展的流程，在机器人学习中展现出巨大前景，但由于视频生成不完善或动作预测不准确，其动作标签常常存在噪声。最近，视觉-语言模型（VLM）已被用于验证视频质量，但它们无法直接评估生成的动作本身。为解决这一问题，我们提出了RoboCurate，一个新颖的动作验证合成机器人数据框架，用于解决生成视频与标注动作之间的不一致性。具体而言，RoboCurate在模拟器中执行由逆动力学模型（IDM）预测的动作，并通过测量模拟器回放与生成视频之间的运动一致性来验证动作的一致性。为了更好地利用该框架，我们进一步通过现成的生成模型扩展了合成数据的场景多样性，使其超越现有可用数据集的范围……
tldr: 提出RoboCurate框架，通过在模拟器中执行IDM预测的动作并对比模拟器回放与生成视频的运动一致性来验证合成数据的动作标签，同时扩展场景多样性，为机器人学习提供高质量、可扩展的合成数据。
en_tdlr: RoboCurate is a novel framework that verifies action labels of synthetic robot data by executing IDM-predicted actions in a simulator and measuring motion agreement between the simulator rollout and the generated video, while expanding scene diversity for scalable robot learning.
